evidence.quote: Satan’s Whiskers is Bethnal Green’s original neighbourhood cocktail bar

not_found: accessibility.step_free (the site has no access page; the reservations page covers phone bookings and walk-ins only)
notes: A cocktail bar. Its own site gives opening hours on the home page (early evening opening, later at weekends) and says walk-in guests are accepted, with reservations by telephone only (reservations page, read 13 Oct 2026). The site's internal links are shop, terms, shipping and reservations; no access, FAQ or age page was found at the usual addresses (/faq and /contact returned 404). Access is unknown, so leave the step-free and toilet fields empty.
